name: Pass 28 production handoff control-plane bundle validation
goal: Ensure production handoff bundles prove their control graph, work ledger, and refinery gate references against actual records.
risks: Outage drill control_graph_node could name a node that does not exist
Outage drill work_ledger_item could point to an unrelated ledger
Production handoff refinery_gate could point to a gate file that is missing or not passing

nodes.label: Pass 28 control-plane bundle critic review

node_contract.what: Review whether production handoff bundles prove control-plane references against actual files.
node_contract.why: The original transcript requires governed handoff evidence, not ID-shaped strings.
node_contract.how: Inspect pass 27 validator, fixtures, pass 26 records, and runner coverage for control-plane file checks.
node_contract.where: df-production-sre-handoff validator and DFMS hardening runner.
node_contract.who: Codex using governance, SRE, and verification expert lenses.
node_contract.how_good: Every finding becomes executable validation or an explicit residual risk.

nodes.feedback_loop: Any unproven governance edge becomes validator logic and a hardening-runner fixture.

nodes.label: Control-plane bundle validator implementation

node_contract.what: Require production handoffs to validate against actual control graph, work ledger, and refinery gate files.
node_contract.why: Operational records must be linked to the same governance objects that accepted them.
node_contract.how: Add --control-graph, --work-ledger, and --refinery-gate arguments, compare IDs and node presence, and add regression checks.
node_contract.where: Installed and workspace df-production-sre-handoff validators plus runner.
node_contract.when: After critic review and before verification closure.
node_contract.how_good: Complete control-plane bundle passes; missing or mismatched control-plane evidence fails.

nodes.feedback_loop: Rerun the full hardening suite after every control-plane bundle change.
gates: missing and mismatched control-plane fixtures reject

nodes.label: Pass 28 verification sweep

node_contract.why: Control-plane bundle hardening only counts if the full suite and merged records pass.
node_contract.how: Run hardening suite, merged-record validation, hash sync, JSON, ASCII, and artifact ID checks.
node_contract.where: Workspace validation suite and pass 28 records.
node_contract.when: After all fixes and records are written.
node_contract.how_good: All checks pass and residual risks remain explicit.

nodes.feedback_loop: Any failed check reopens the fix node.
